source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 3 (ISL A3) · lesson 16. Rewritten for children from Dr. Hassan's lesson; facts and references kept.
topic: Zamzam, the test, and the Kaʿbah

learn.en: By Allah's command, Ibrahim took Hājar and baby Ismāʿīl to an empty valley — where Makkah is today. Hājar asked: “Did Allah command you?” He said yes. She said: “Then He will not leave us.” (Bukhari 3364)
learn.title: Trust in Allah

learn.en: When the water ran out, Hājar ran seven times between the hills of Ṣafā and Marwah. Then an angel struck the ground and water gushed out — Zamzam! That running is the saʿy of ḥajj. (Bukhari 3364)
learn.title: Zamzam

learn.en: When Ismāʿīl was older, Ibrahim saw in a dream that he must sacrifice him. Ismāʿīl said: “O my father, do as you are commanded; you will find me patient, if Allah wills.” (Qur'an 37:102)
learn.title: A patient son

learn.en: When they both obeyed, Allah saved Ismāʿīl and sent a ram instead. (Qur'an 37:104–107) We remember this every year at Eid al-Aḍḥā.
learn.title: Eid al-Aḍḥā

learn.en: Ibrahim and Ismāʿīl built the Kaʿbah together, praying: “Our Lord, accept this from us.” (Qur'an 2:127)
learn.title: Building the Kaʿbah

quiz.en: How many times did Hājar run between Ṣafā and Marwah?
Which well burst out for Hājar and Ismāʿīl?
True or false? Ibrahim and Ismāʿīl built the Kaʿbah together.
True or false? Ismāʿīl refused to obey.

move.ar: اجْرِ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالمَرْوَةِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ!
move.en: Run between two “hills” (two chairs) seven times, like Hājar!

think.q: Hājar ran AND trusted Allah. What does that teach us about tawakkul?
think.a: Do your best, then trust Allah to take care of the rest.

parents.summary: Hājar trusted Allah and Zamzam burst out; Ismāʿīl was patient; Ibrahim obeyed. From this family we have saʿy, Eid al-Aḍḥā and the Kaʿbah.
parents.tip: Next time you drink water, tell the story of Zamzam.
